name: Inventory Master
notes: Initial release of Inventory Master with 12 conflict-free QoL features: Auto Sort, 15-slot Backpack Expansion, 20-slot Hotbar Swap, 5m Auto Pickup, Drop Protection, Smart Split, Auto Tool Equip & Replace, Fast Bulk Transfer, One-Click Storage Dump, Favorite Items Lock, Trash Slot with Undo, and Auto Refill!
